tbesh_html:
§ Gihon = "bursting forth"
one of the four rivers of the Garden of Eden

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Gichon, a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) גִּחוֹן; from H1518 (גִּיחַ)lemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; stream;
